raw:
@q query
  mode every
  where match
    relation "be in"
    role subject ?x
    role object "the mobile squad"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  scope match
    relation "complete the security awareness training"
    role subject ?x
    polarity negated
  end

@q2 query
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "be in"
      role subject ?x
      role object "the mobile squad"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "complete the security awareness training"
      role subject ?x
      polarity negated
    end
  end
